resources.string: Choose files to copy into %1$s once. Originals stay where they are.
Choose files to upload to %1$s once. Originals stay on your device.
No writable destination is available for this source. Existing media remains available for browsing.

Your collections above already supply the media. Folder collections pick up new files automatically; Photo picker and Files collections contain only your selections. To copy extra files here, add a writable folder collection, or use the Add button inside a selected-media collection.
Save your changes before adding media or changing folder imports.
Could not load imports. Check the saved connection and that SAO is up to date.
Finishes the current file, clears other unfinished imports and pauses folder imports. Originals and completed imports are kept.

Choose device folders to upload their existing files and future additions to this source’s saved destination. Android checks about every six hours, using an unmetered connection. Originals stay on your device; deleting them does not delete uploads.
Stops future imports and cancels pending items from this folder. Originals and completed uploads are kept.
Upload access was refused. Check this profile’s credentials and destination permissions.
The saved configuration changed. Save and reopen this profile to confirm its destination.
Folder access is unavailable. Reselect the folder to restore access.
The transfer could not finish. Temporary failures retry with increasing delays, up to five attempts.
A file changed or is no longer available. Check folders again for its current version.
Not enough space to prepare this media.
An import needs attention. Completed imports are kept.
Your edits have not been saved.
